q: How often should I schedule a cleaning service?
a: It depends on your lifestyle, budget and needs. We recommend weekly or bi-weekly. Weekly suits high-traffic homes, homes with pets, or anyone who doesn't want to maintain between cleans. Bi-weekly suits lower-traffic homes with few or no shedding pets. Monthly suits very low-traffic homes where you'll keep up between visits.

q: Will I get the same cleaners every time?
a: Yes. We assign the same trusted cleaner or team to your home unless you request otherwise.

q: How long will my clean take?
a: It depends on your home's size, condition, and the service you choose. Every quote includes a clear time estimate so you know exactly what to expect.

Natural, non-toxic, eco-friendly products, including Branch Basics. Everything we use is free from sulfates, phosphates, phthalates, parabens, VOCs, SLS, SLES, petroleum solvents, dyes, synthetic fragrances, and endocrine disruptors. If you'd like us to use specific products, just let us know.

q: Do I need to be home during my clean?
a: Not at all. Many clients aren't. Share entry instructions and we'll handle the rest. If you work from home, we keep noise to a minimum.

q: What should I do before my cleaner arrives?
a: For the most efficient and effective clean, please pick up personal belongings before we arrive.

q: What services do you not offer?
a: Carpet cleaning, biohazard cleaning, floor refinishing, moving furniture, cleaning electronics (TVs, computers, tablets), cleaning musical instruments, and cleaning animal or human waste.

q: What is your cancellation or reschedule policy?
a: We require at least 48 hours' notice for all cancellations and reschedules.
